title.narrative: Advancing Resilient Societies in the Maghreb through Risk-Informed Pathways and Multi-Hazards Preparadeness

description.narrative: The Maghreb region faces increasing multi-hazard risks from climate, technological, and socioeconomic pressures, requiring strengthened capacities, risk awareness, and adaptive governance. UNESCO Maghreb supports regional coordination, knowledge exchange, and evidence-based dialogue to enhance disaster risk reduction and resilient societies. It will facilitate regional consultations and online meetings to review and modernize building codes, identify gaps, and generate recommendations for adaptation. These efforts will also produce a UNESCO Maghreb publication on resilience, building codes, and societal transformation. As a result, regional coordination and partnerships will be reinforced, capacities and knowledge on multi-hazard risks will be enhanced, and a regional evidence base for resilient infrastructure and socio-ecological systems will be established.
